name: labs/tipith__py6632b
title: HP 6632B DC source (py6632B.HP6632B)
intro: HP 6632B DC source (py6632B.HP6632B), adapted from tipith/py6632b. It reads `voltage`, `current`, `output_enabled` and `identity`; runs `set_source`, `set_output` and `stop_output`. `set_source`: set the output voltage and current limit together with one native SOUR:VOLT/CURR command. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/tipith__py6632b --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/tipith__py6632b --backend fake --mcp
